title: Vitex agnus-castus tea for medicinal use
intro: Vitex agnus-castus tea is made from the dried flowers of the chasteberry plant, which has been used for centuries in traditional herbal medicine. It is commonly used to support hormonal balance, particularly in women, to alleviate symptoms related to menstruation, PMS, and menopause. The tea is believed to influence the pituitary gland and regulate the production of hormones like prolactin and estrogen. It is often prepared by steeping the dried flowers in hot water for several minutes. In herbalism, it is also used to address issues such as irregular menstrual cycles and emotional symptoms associated with hormonal fluctuations.
